name: t3-kemeny-pullmajority-v1
convention: lower score = predicted better day_b rank; scores are PREDICTED
chosen_on: design data only (snapshot days <= 2026-11-17), see evals/claude/t3-movers/notes.md
prev_weight_note: Earlier days break exact day_a ties only. A day_a pull moves a pair's weighted margin by 0.5 or 0, an earlier pull by at most 0.5 * its weight; prev_cap 0.9 keeps the earlier total below 1, so a strict day_a majority always wins. 0.1 rather than 0.001 so an earlier-day margin beats the 1e-3 consensus tie-break in the Kemeny objective.
